Join Us

ROSA Lab welcomes motivated undergraduate, Master's, and Ph.D. students who are excited to work on mathematically grounded research with real-world impact.

Research Interests

Our research interests include Graph Theory and Optimization, Artificial Intelligence, Data Mining, Reinforcement Learning, Social Network Analysis, Recommender Systems, Federated Learning, and LLM-related research.

How to Apply

Please send your CV/resume and transcript by email if you are interested in joining ROSA Lab.

ncurosalab@gmail.com

We also welcome inquiries by email if you would like to learn more about current opportunities, research directions, or the lab environment before applying.
